purpose: Two deterministic shadow candidates; no public strategy promotion or option qualification.
genuine_input: Ordered same-feed regular-session minute OHLCV, exact minute alignment, no synthetic/continuity-only/indicative inputs. Every minute from 09:30 to the latest completed minute must exist. Current-session prefix only.
minute_trend: CALL: close > EMA9 > EMA21, close > volume-weighted typical-price session VWAP, and exact 15-minute close change > 0. PUT reverses all inequalities. Missing values abstain.
orb: Require all 15 genuine minutes 09:30-09:44. Current completed 5m close crosses strictly beyond the frozen range high/low while previous completed 5m close is on or inside that boundary. Current minute trend must agree.
pullback: Require current minute trend; previous completed 5m candle closes against direction relative to its predecessor and touches/crosses the EMA9 computed through that previous 5m candle. Current completed 5m closes beyond both previous 5m high/low and its own EMA9. Latest completed 15m close moves in direction versus preceding completed 15m and lies on the directional side of session VWAP.
volume: Current completed 5m volume >= 1.2 times the arithmetic mean of the previous three completed 5m volumes; positive observed volumes required. Missing volume is not zero.
entry_reference: Completed confirmation close is a research reference, never a fill. A separately supplied actual quote may be used only after the unchanged strict underlying entry gate passes; quote reference must remain within 0.5 minute ATR14 of the confirmation close.
structural_stop: CALL minimum low / PUT maximum high of the two latest completed 5m candles; stop distance is max(directional structural distance, 0.5 minute Wilder ATR14). Require positive directional distance and valid positive prices.
targets: Target1 = reference + direction*1R; Target2 = reference + direction*2R; full research exit at stop/Target2/deadline, Target1 observation does not realize half or infer a personal sale.
entry_limit: Reference +/- 0.5 minute ATR14 in direction; beyond-limit entry refused.
late_plan_policy: Full H60 must end no later than verified underlying close minus30minutes. No clipping, extension or overnight hold. Entry expiry precedes hold deadline.
arbitration: One public-policy shadow plan per experiment cell at a time. ORB_5M before PULLBACK_5M_15M; signal ID ascending for an impossible equal-priority conflict. Incumbent is a separate frozen comparison cell, not an additional simultaneous public plan.
same_bar_order: When stop and target2 both touched, mark AMBIGUOUS_STOP_TARGET and use adverse stop-first diagnostic. Opening gap through stop uses adverse bar open, not a guaranteed stop fill. No exact intrabar chronology is inferred.
stable_identity: SHA256 of rule digest, family, direction, session, confirmation-end UTC and immutable trigger level. Re-evaluation cannot create a new ID for the same completed crossing.
entry_gate: Actual strict observed_context result required and independently verified quote fields; quote, receipt, heartbeat, continuity, clock, calendar and risk remain external prerequisites. Shadow detection never grants live/option eligibility.
incumbent_comparator: strategies.idea_setups.detect at its pinned spy-ideas-v4-full-h60 version, evaluated on identical completed5m decision clocks, minute prefixes, delayed-entry proxy and one-primary-plan policy. Incumbent source is immutable.
trial_accounting: 3 strategy policies (incumbent plus2candidates) x3delays x2costs =18 policy cells. Direction strata are disclosed separately, not independent trials. FixedH60 long/short baselines x3delays x2costs =12 cells; NO_TRADE =1. Total31 registered policy cells; prior project trials remain additional multiple-testing exposure.
availability: Recorded_at/available_at retained; late historical bars are not available before receipt. Retrospective complete-bar diagnostic may use known-close data only if explicitly labeled unavailable-at-decision evidence absent; never a live readiness result. Requested absent sessions remain missing audit rows.
partition: Every already reviewed date through 2026-11-01 is development-only. Future verified sessions starting2026-11-02 are prospective engineering/evaluation observations; a5session engineering window is not strategy validation. Chronological splits and dataset digests frozen separately before replay; no overlapping outcome crosses a session boundary.
uncertainty: Day-block bootstrap descriptive intervals; independent sessions, turnover, net expectancy, drawdown, missing outcomes and cost/delay sensitivity retained. No automatic winner; no calibrated forecast probability.
option_performance: NOT_MEASURED without genuine matching point-in-time chain/BBO/Greek history and preserved executable ask-entry/bid-exit costs. Underlying proxy R or dollar-per-share return is not option profit.
parameter_search: None: parameters are frozen before this replay. A future alteration requires a new version/trial and independent evidence.
